_spec.purpose: 30 day subject dedupe. The angle room and Phase 3 MUST read this before picking a story, and Phase 7 MUST append after delivery. A subject may not repeat within 30 days, and a BEAT should not run twice in any 3 episodes.

entries.subject: microsoft-365-packaging-and-pricing-update
entries.summary: Price rise called a 'packaging and pricing update'; the official FAQ contains no prices.

entries.subject: ford-pedestrian-alert-recall-expansion-26V415000
entries.summary: Recalled 43,438 in Oct 2025 for a pedestrian warning sound, fixed by software, letters mailed Nov 5; in Jun 2026 the same recall came back covering 66,383 and the repaired cars must be repaired again.

entries.subject: rentgrow-tenant-screening-duplicate-records-ftc
entries.summary: The FTC alleges RentGrow's tenant screening reports carried duplicate entries for the same eviction action, so applicants looked like they had been sued for eviction more times than they actually had. Disputes were sometimes labelled invalid with no further action. Settled; a settlement is not an admission.

entries.subject: medicare-advantage-prior-authorization-denials-overturned-on-appeal-oig
entries.target: UnitedHealth Group, Inc. and its subsidiary naviHealth
entries.summary: HHS OIG found UnitedHealth overturned 99.7 percent of appealed skilled-nursing denials, and that only 18 percent were ever appealed.
